title: Fantastic Mr Fox
author: Roald Dahl
summary: Mr Fox steals food each night from three mean farmers, Boggis, Bunce and Bean. They set out to get him, so the fox and his family dig deeper to outwit them.
readIf: you want a short, clever and cheeky animal tale to read aloud to children.
skipIf: you are after a long or emotionally complex story for older readers.
